placements.title: from renting intelligence to owning the perspective that generates it
placements.frame: Where does the enduring value of intelligence reside — in the substrate that can be commoditized, or in the perspective that is kept?
placements.why: src-2 and src-3 perform a single thematic thesis: owned intelligence is categorically distinct from rented intelligence, and the enduring value resides in perspective (the asset you keep) rather than substrate (the commodity). This is a directional statement of meaning that future envelopes could continue feeding — it names a subject, not a one-time fact. No existing leaf or strata holds this theme; the graph and strata are both empty.
